_comment:
The about-to-break wobble. A PROP role with no needsAnyOf, so any prop can rattle.

One channel only: alternating whole-actor dx, 0.18s apart — a shade over the two-frame floor at 12fps, which is the fastest a wobble can go and still be SEEN rather than aliasing into a blur.

EVERY MOVE BEAT CARRIES AN EXPLICIT `duration`, AND MUST. A move cue with no duration runs its tween to the END OF THE SHOT (ToonProject.swift: `cue.duration.map { ... } ?? (shotStart + duration)`), so an 0.18s swing would complete about a tenth of its travel before the next beat superseded it — and the next swing, starting from that barely-moved position and heading the other way, cancels it. Authored at +/-0.022 this gag rendered at +/-0.0006 and the prop stood still. A short duration makes each swing LAND on its extreme within one frame and HOLD there until the next, which is what a rattle actually is.

The amplitude ESCALATES, 0.006 to 0.022: a constant-amplitude shake is a machine, a growing one is something losing the argument with gravity. eased:false so each swing snaps rather than gliding.

It deliberately does NOT break the prop — it stops on a shake, a dust puff and a settle back to the mark, so it can be dropped in front of topple-over or used alone for a thing that survives. The settle is the one eased move, and its duration is bounded too so it actually REACHES dx 0 before the cut: position is never auto-restored by the binder (only scale is), so an unfinished settle leaks to the end of the scene.
triggers: rattling as if it might break

object._comment: No needsAnyOf. Nothing has to be declared for a prop to shake.

beats._comment: eased:false throughout — a wobble SNAPS between extremes. Whole-actor moves ease by default, which would round the corners off the rattle and make it read as a gentle sway.
second strain, louder, at the halfway mark — the audio escalates with the amplitude
widest swing of the gag, and the last one
the camera finally joins in, at the peak
the sound of something giving — but nothing actually breaks. The threat is the gag.
dust shaken loose at the base
and it settles. Eased this time, in contrast to the twelve snaps before it, and back to the mark — so this gag needs no separate hygiene beat.
